title: Soul Snack #73: Why is it Important to Experience Physical Sensations?
excerpt: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
bodyHtml:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen HERE.

In this illuminating episode, Gary Zukav reveals why experiencing physical sensations in your body is essential to creating Authentic Power. Set within the context of humanity’s unprecedented shift in consciousness, Gary guides you to understand that painful physical sensations – felt within your energy centers – are not caused by the external world, but by the internal dynamics of your own personality. Through his compassionate wisdom, he explains how most people exhaust their energy pursuing external power – attempting to change the world or others to find relief – when real transformation requires looking inward to change the dynamics that create those sensations.

The central challenge facing multisensory humanity is the five-sensory tendency to seek relief from painful emotions by manipulating the external environment. 

This pursuit of external power can only create temporary happiness, a fleeting high that inevitably fades. Whether it is acquiring a material object or demanding an apology, these external shifts cannot permanently alter the frightened parts of the personality that are creating your painful sensations.

The solution lies in creating Authentic Power by cultivating Emotional Awareness, looking deeply at what is occurring within you, and making the Responsible Choice to respond with love instead of reacting with fear. When you shift your focus from changing the world to transforming yourself, you ignite a joy that is not dependent on external circumstances. This is the path of the Universal Human.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:00) — The Gateway to Self-Awareness: Gary explains how experiencing physical sensations allows you to see the internal dynamics of your personality creating them, rather than wasting time pursuing external power to change the world.
  • (01:35) — The Activation of Internal Dynamics: Understanding how external events and your thoughts about them activate the dynamics within you—the frightened parts of your personality – that create painful physical sensations.
  • (02:30) — The Roller Coaster of External Power: Gary uses a powerful analogy to illustrate how changing the external world creates only temporary happiness, while Authentic Power ignites joy that is independent of circumstances.
  • (03:56) — Responding with Love vs. Reacting with Fear: Discovering the profound difference between making the Responsible Choice to consciously respond with love to what the world activates in you and automatically reacting from fear.
  • (04:30) — The Futility of Changing Others: Learning why trying to change your spiritual partner, friend, or pursuing the external power of being “right” will not change the dynamics creating your painful sensations.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take a moment this week to notice when you experience a painful physical sensation in your body. Instead of immediately looking to the external world to make it go away, pause and ask yourself: What internal dynamic might be creating this sensation? Have I been trying to change someone or something outside of me to feel better? Notice what happens when you shift your attention inward and become curious about what this sensation is revealing about yourself. Can you choose to respond with love to this information rather than react with fear?
